offering_description.value: Organogenesis supplies clinicians with regenerative tissue products for advanced wound care, surgery, and sports medicine. It operates biomanufacturing facilities and provides support to clinicians.

quotes.quote: From advanced wound care through surgery and sports medicine, we are committed to empowering healing by confidently and reliably delivering clinicians the range of regenerative tissue innovations along with the services they need.
Our headquarters are in Canton, MA, with additional facilities for biomanufacturing, commercial operations, and R&D, as well as an international office in Reinach, Switzerland.

primary_products.value: Regenerative tissue products for wound and burn care; regenerative tissue products for surgery and sports medicine

quotes.quote: Organogenesis delivers regenerative tissue innovations in advanced wound care, surgery, and sports medicine, empowering healing with leading products and support.
Our new state-of-the-art facility in Smithfield strengthens our legacy in regenerative medicine and supports our leading burn and wound care products.
